risk_description: Unauthorized access to payroll database due to weak password policy
Employee accidentally emails salary data to wrong recipient
Third-party payroll vendor suffers a data breach
Backup restoration fails during disaster recovery test
Terminated employee retains system access due to delayed offboarding
Phishing email leads to compromised HR admin credentials
Outdated software version has unpatched known vulnerability
Physical office break-in leads to stolen laptop with local data
Misconfigured cloud storage bucket left publicly accessible
Insufficient logging prevents detection of unauthorized data export
Single point of failure - one employee holds all admin credentials
Spreadsheet-based leave tracking causes payroll calculation errors
No multi-factor authentication on finance system logins
Data retention policy not enforced, old records never purged
Untested incident response plan for a payroll system outage
